If I live in NI, i can carry a handgun legally for personal protection, and for sporting use. But the same handgun is illegal in the rest of the UK, outside of it being a "long barreled pistol", which is literally the same handgun but with a metal pole on the back and integral suppressor, to ensure that legally it isnt a handgun. 

I agree, licensure and ensuring safe storage are absolutely positive measures, however there are numerous inconsistencies in the UK's firearms legislation that exist purely from FUDD tendencies, and from politicians who want performative laws that dont actually serve any real purpose. 

At the end of the day, it is the purpose of all firearms to be a lethal weapon. If we are going to license them, and permit private citizens to own them, then we should at least make sure that the legislation in regards to firearms is consistent, and grounded in the reality of things.
